comparison.objective: Clip three carabiners into a closed-gate chain hanging from a stand; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Gate actuation, link insertion, sequential chain assembly, and hanging-load handling versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammering, and metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each linked carabiner has a closed gate and forms the released hanging chain; candidate requires four fractures, four contained fragments, and no retained-part damage.
comparison.reason: Sequential latching assembly differs from controlled notch fracture and post-fracture containment. The record lacks numeric gate/chain tolerances.
